labels.reason: The table contains fitted population parameters rather than measured concentration-time observations. Its notes describe four intraperitoneal regimens, sampling, plasma bioassay and a NONMEM model with Michaelis-Menten elimination and enzyme autoinduction. Between-rat variability is reported for V, V max and k enz; these estimates do not supply individual observations or verified animal identifiers. Mean has no single column-wide unit: units are written in the parameter row labels, and V and Vmax are explicitly per animal. Concentration basis, dose formulation basis, individual records, body weight and binding measurements remain unspecified or unavailable as described. All supplied source units were reviewed; requirement links indicate partial input support only.

evidence.quote: Population pharmacokinetic parameters of VOR in rats (autoinduction model)
S06 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.01556-08 | Table 2 (van de Sande et al. 2009)

Neutropenic female RP strain albino rats (age and weight not reported); PK groups of 9 uninfected neutropenic rats. Vfend INTRAPERITONEAL q12h for 10 days in four regimens: 2.6 mg/kg; 5 mg/kg; 6, 8, 10, 11 mg/kg on days 1-4 then 12 mg/kg; 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15 mg/kg on days 1-4 then 17.5 mg/kg. Sampling days 0, 5 and 9, three times per rat (0, 2, 8 h; 0.5, 4, 10 h; 1, 6, 12 h); retro-orbital plasma; agar-diffusion bioassay (C. albicans), standards 0.125-4 µg/ml; binding not measured.

NONMEM model with Michaelis-Menten elimination and enzyme autoinduction: "the amount of enzyme is increased sixfold on the last day, producing a comparable increase in the Vmax." Footnote a: "Standard errors of the estimates were <42%." V in ml and Vmax in μg/h are per animal.
Measured concentrations are in Fig. 1 only (days 0 and 9 at 7.5 and 17.5 mg/kg; not digitized; legend does not say whether dots are individual rats).

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A24-A26 provide provenance, reported parameters, regimens, sampling context, plasma matrix and bioassay information. A27 explicitly places measured concentrations in an undigitized figure outside the supplied table. Individual identifiers, concentration records, detection limits and missing-value definitions are not supplied. The assay standards range is not an explicitly stated LLOQ. Empty variability cells have no stated meaning.
findings.needed_material: During authorized preparation, retain this as a reported-parameter table, carry text-only values separately for confirmation, preserve empty cells and obtain source-backed observation and missingness metadata where available.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 establishes intraperitoneal repeat dosing, uninfected neutropenic female RP strain albino rats, plasma and agar-diffusion bioassay. Total versus unbound basis, salt or free-base dose basis, sampling-time origin, grapefruit-juice exposure, co-medication and meningitis status are not stated. No day-2 designation is supported. A26 states that V and Vmax are per animal.
findings.needed_material: Preserve these distinctions and unknowns; clarify sampling-time origin and concentration and dose bases from authorized evidence before any dependent conversion or pooling. Record row-specific parameter units without assigning one unit to the entire Mean column.

findings.reason: Status DEFERRED; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at pk. Origin: main:/missing_information/items/5. Animal PK model support and design-permitted evaluation: SC022 makes model choices and evaluation conditional on data and design support; the proposal does not supply that assessment. Supported mouse and rat model structures and permitted predictive checks cannot yet be determined. For DRQ006, F0003:S2:T2:A26 supplies a published rat model description with Michaelis-Menten elimination and autoinduction, and A25 supplies sampling context; these do not establish fit, identifiability, held-out units or a supported new model.
findings.needed_material: Assess the prepared evidence for the conditional choices in SC022 and retain unsupported or unassessable components as limitations.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 provides nominal regimens and sampling schedules, but A27 states that measured concentrations occur only in an undigitized figure with uncertain dot identity. The table supplies parameter estimates, not concentration-time modeling records. Verified experimental-unit identifiers, observed dosing events, actual sampling times, figure extraction provenance and observation-level censoring metadata are unavailable on this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed concentration-time records and their authorized extraction provenance, study and regimen membership, sampling-unit definitions and relevant missingness metadata before assessing model input sufficiency.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 describes four dose histories and sampling days 0, 5 and 9, providing candidate dose and treatment-history contrasts. It does not supply concentration records linked to those contrasts or actual prior administration records. A27 describes only figure coverage for days 0 and 9 at 7.5 and 17.5 mg/kg; it does not establish a complete factorial design or identify a mechanism.
findings.needed_material: Maintain separate regimen histories and obtain source-backed concentration links, dose-event histories and sampling origins where authorized. Leave support for nonlinear or time-dependent mechanisms to the animal PK module.

findings.reason: Status DEFERRED; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at pk. Origin: main:/missing_information/items/6. Support for individual PK variability: the proposal distinguishes summaries and predictions from individual observations and prohibits invented variability in SC027 and SC038; attachment-level support remains unassessed. Individual variability cannot be used defensibly in animal modeling or carried into human simulations until its evidential basis is established. For DRQ009, C28/C30/C32/C33 report between-rat variability, and A26 reports an estimate-standard-error bound. The variability distribution and parameterization are unspecified, and A27 does not establish individual dot identity. Published variability and parameter uncertainty must remain distinct from supplied individual observations and residual variability.
findings.needed_material: Determine whether authorized individual-level evidence supports variability estimation; otherwise preserve the limitation without constructing variability from summaries.

findings.reason: Status DEFERRED; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at human_pk. Origin: main:/missing_information/items/7. Supported human translation inputs and relationships: the proposal specifies the translation considerations in SC023 but leaves their supported implementation to later assessment. A justified human scaling approach cannot yet be selected. For DRQ012, A26 supplies source-reported nonlinearity and autoinduction context, while A25 explicitly says weight is not reported and binding was not measured. This page does not supply justified human physiological relationships, qualified upstream model outputs or identification of the human-target-matched escalating regimen.
findings.needed_material: Establish and document the supported inputs and physiological relationships for SC023, including how nonlinearity and autoinduction are addressed. Obtain source-supported identification of the regimen excluded from scaling tuning without inferring it from escalation alone.

findings.reason: This page contributes candidate reported parameters for one species only. A25 identifies the rat strain, sex and immune and infection state but states that weight is not reported. A26 specifies per-animal V and Vmax. The table does not define all parameter mappings, including the meaning of k 12, or qualify parameters for cross-species transfer. Multiple regimens do not add species.
findings.needed_material: Reuse this source-linked rat inventory with its reported-parameter status. Before any size-based translation, obtain actual study body weights and clarify parameter definitions, normalization and approach-specific comparability; do not substitute typical weights.

findings.reason: Status DEFERRED; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at validation. Origin: main:/missing_information/items/2. Access to human validation data: human validation data are not in the supplied package. The separate reference file described in SC018 is released only at task 5, after the animal model, scaling and predictions are frozen. Independent human validation must await the authorized release. This rat parameter page supplies no evidence of the release or freeze records required by DRQ020 and is not matched to that requirement.
findings.needed_material: Release the separate human reference file only at the specified stage after the required freezes; do not access its outcomes earlier.

findings.reason: A26 gives a global footnote a stating that standard errors were <42%, but no supplied body cell carries the marker. C28 names between-rat variability (%) without defining whether it is CV or another parameterization. The reported enzyme increase is model context, not a separately measured enzyme time course.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the footnote scope and variability definition from authorized source evidence before using these estimates quantitatively; retain the original wording and do not infer a distribution or numerical standard error.

findings.reason: A27 repeats days 0 and 9 and doses 7.5 and 17.5 mg/kg already appearing in the broader sampling and regimen description in A25. These are repeated contextual values with different textual scopes, not additional observations or independent animals. No conflicting numerical value was found in the supplied page.
findings.needed_material: Preserve both occurrences and their scopes in the stated-value ledger; confirm their relationships during preparation without manufacturing dose-day pairings or observation records.
